adjudication.rationale: In `packages/emails/email-manager.ts`, the new `sendAddGuestsEmails` builds `emailsToSend` by pushing an organizer email, one per team member (loop over `calendarEvent.team.members`), and then one per attendee via `calendarEvent.attendees.map(...)`, and finally executes `await Promise.all(emailsToSend);`. There is no concurrency limiting or batching, so large attendee/team lists will trigger an unbounded burst of parallel SMTP sends, which is a concrete scalability/operational concern introduced by this diff, though not a direct functional correctness defect.
